loops.label: chaosb-sl-3
loops.note: Recovered from chain receipts after the driver process failed during this chaos attempt. Sequence: the pre-noise swap set the price to 2984.18; the driver transferred 15.9076 WETH into the pair for its 2300 stop-loss trigger (transfer tx above, block 64260713), but its swap call reverted at gas estimation (ReflexPair: no input) and was never broadcast, leaving the transferred WETH sitting in the pair. The mid-loop noise swap (origin tx above, block 64260731) then executed against the pair; the pair accounted the stranded WETH as part of that swap token0 input (Swap event amount0In 15.9076) alongside the noise trader USDC input, and the resulting Sync set the price to 2676.21, below the 2700 stop-loss band. The guardian triggered on that Sync (reactive tx above) and the callback executed a genuine full 10 WETH protective sale for 24,765.25 USDC at block 64260735, 4 blocks after the origin swap. The driver had exited with an error before recording the loop, so this record was reconstructed entirely from chain receipts and verified with the independent auditor.
